title: Mansoor Delane, Travis Kelce limited at Chiefs practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mansoor Delane, Travis Kelce limited at Chiefs practice
sources.description: Chiefs cornerback Mansoor Delane missed last Sunday's loss to the Broncos with a shoulder injury and his outlook for Week 9's home game against the Jets looks a little better after Wednesday's practice.
